thread:
nina_ops: Heads-up: Stratix delivered an APAC mini-batch. 10 H100s arrived at KUL-hub, 4 units failed POST. Vendor proposing 4x air to SIN-depot for swap, rest ground. Need decision on expedite cost split and insurance. @leo_procurement @maya_logistics

leo_procurement: Please request serials, DOA photos, and a detailed air quote (carrier, fuel surcharge, handling, insurance). If they want an expedite share >30% they must provide invoices. Which ledger to charge? Recommend infra-capex for hardware replacements.

maya_logistics: If air, route to SIN-depot-2 for same-day bench swap. Depot requires manifest_v5 CSV + 24h pre-alert. Carrier options: SQ, MH. ETA 36-48h after AWB. Depot will refuse crossdock.

raj_platform: Cluster note: APAC pool = 140 H100s. Removing 4 reduces capacity ~2.8%; low but could impact queued training jobs. I can shift some batch jobs to EU and spin up 1 hot-spare in APAC for 24h. Cost est ~$750/day. Approve?

nina_ops: Vendor note: failures = "no POST / nvlink error" for the 4. Serial list (redacted): H100-STX-501, H100-STX-502, H100-STX-503, H100-STX-504. Air quote = $12,800 + customs + insurance. Vendor asks for 50% expedite fee share and asks us to handle customs clearance.

leo_procurement: 50% is excessive. Counter 25% expedite if vendor covers customs and insurance and provides carrier receipts. Require signed DOA form and timestamped photos before release of expedite payment. Also ask vendor to include declared value for customs.

maya_logistics: Agreed on documentation. Depot manifest example (manifest_v5):

```
AWB,Carrier,ShipFrom,ShipTo,ItemCount,Serials,HSCode,DeclaredValue,Insurance,RMA_type
TBD,TBD,Stratix,SIN-depot-2,4,"H100-STX-501;H100-STX-502;H100-STX-503;H100-STX-504",84733000,425000,yes,swap
```

No exceptions without legal sign-off.

raj_platform: If vendor accepts 25% + vendor covers customs/insurance, proceed with air and I'll reserve 1 hot-spare. If vendor refuses, choose sea-return for repair (ETA ~12 business days).

nina_ops: Uploaded preliminary run logs and photos: https://files.redwood.internal/rma/3612349999/ (placeholder). Vendor replied: "we'll accept 30% if Redwood issues AWB within 6h and signs PO addendum." They also claim carrier surge = 40% of air fee.

leo_procurement: Counter-offer: 30% expedite only if vendor provides carrier invoice and agrees to cover customs/insurance. No PO addendum until legal reviews. Also require COA and DOA sign-off. Tagging legal for addendum review.

maya_logistics: Action items:
1) nina_ops - upload full serial manifest + failure logs + timestamped DOA photos by 11:30 MYT.
2) leo_procurement - draft PO amendment w/ 30% counter and requirement for carrier receipts + vendor to pay customs/insurance.
3) maya_logistics - provision SIN-depot-2 conditional slot and pre-alert template.
4) raj_platform - reserve 1 hot-spare in APAC pool for 24h if AWB issued.
SLA target: 72h from AWB to swap complete. :white_check_mark:

remind_bot: Reminder set - follow up with Stratix in 4h if AWB or carrier receipts not provided.

nina_ops: Chasing Stratix now. If they won't cover customs/insurance, escalate to finance.

leo_procurement: Noted. Finance/legal thread queued if vendor insists on non-standard terms. We shouldn't commit >30% expedite without receipts. :thumbsup:
